comparison: independent actual-point closed-loop teacher; not same q trajectory as source-only replay
scope: one original target per precommitted row; b1; source press maps to local3s via explicit phrase offset
preparation: 0.5s reference hold then simultaneous2s source-q/B ramp, bounded point+wrist feedback from2.5s to original note end
terminations: physical and wrist unchanged; first episode includes failure; resets only after completed boundaries
state_writes: normal prepared episode resets only; finite39 actions thereafter

teacher.start: at2.5s after simultaneous2s source-q/B ramp and0.5s reference hold; stop feedback at original selected note end
teacher.point: nearest actual eligible pad sample fixed at first correction
teacher.goal: original target cell center and press-plane -0.5mm; predicates unchanged
teacher.wrist_constraint: nearest point in original guidebox expanded19mm; wrist error rows active only outside this target; no guide/termination change
teacher.load_guard: at >=2N remove inward pad error; keep tangent/outward pad and wrist tasks; project smoothed target step to non-inward half-space within native action bounds; zero fallback if projection fails
teacher.prediction_limit: native instantaneous point Jacobian first-order target-step prediction; no guarantee on actual dynamic penetration
teacher.native_J: body-1 index; point offset from COM; existing thumb point_jacobian helper
teacher.limitation: diagnostic teacher, no RL/BC and no target or physical-state overwrite
